population.heldout_guard: split must equal development before specialist invocation

unit_of_analysis: unique region identity (kind, image_id, region_index); linked GT annotations are scored separately but do not inflate treatment units

arms.T: same source image and exact frozen baseline region bbox passed to existing TableTransformer crop treatment path

treatment_input_invariants: source image hash equals frozen 039 manifest
treatment bbox equals frozen baseline bbox exactly
crop hash is computed from the exact PIL RGB crop
OCR and layout are not rerun or changed
GT is not passed to the specialist
treatment output is isolated from 039 baseline roots

all: GT IoU >= 0.3, evaluated only after treatment
maximum overlap with any baseline production table <= 0.1

falsification_tests.B: crop-specific structure versus crop/page-wide detector evidence
falsification_tests.C: shared oversized regions as an explanation for successes
falsification_tests.D: control material false positives and ownership harm

stop_conditions: unexpected PAGE_WIDE or NOT_INVOKED treatment mode
aggregation: paired region-level primary analysis; GT-table-level multiplicity reported separately; policy-family subsets use pre-treatment indicators computed before treatment
